mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (user_id, project_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS comment_id, u.nickname AS writer_name, c.content, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, CASE WHEN c.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_editable FROM comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS comment_id, p.id AS project_id, p.title AS project_title, c.content, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at FROM comment c JOIN project p ON c.project_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS comment_id, u.nickname AS writer_name, c.content, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, IF(c.user_id = #{currentUserId}, 1, 0) AS is_editable FROM comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{commentId}
